pkg.editor.title: Skin Package Properties
pkg.editor.partsHint:
Same from means the same part position. Textures can be picked from other skin packages of the same vehicle to fill missing parts; parts set to 'Not Set' are not output and the game uses its default texture.
Candidates also include textures from other vehicles with the same from, marked as 'Cross-Vehicle'.
Tags next to part names are inferred from naming conventions and are for reference only.
pkg.editor.partNone: None, this part is not output
pkg.editor.mode.notice:
The write mode of a part is being modified. Please confirm the following:

• replace_tex: Replaces the original texture of this part; used by most parts.
• set_tex: Sets a camo skin texture; also writes param:t="camo_skin_tex" and is generally used only for the main camouflage texture of hull/airframe.

Incorrect usage does not cause game errors, but the skin may not take effect or may behave abnormally.

Choosing '{0}': applies this change and never prompts again; choosing '{1}': makes no changes this time and prompts again next time.
